rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone enthusiastic and determined to achieve a goal.

example.english: They are very motivated to study for the university entrance exam.
example.traditional: 佢為咗考入大學，最近好有動力溫書。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 zo2 haau2 jap6 daai6 hok6 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 jau5 dung6 lik6 wan1 syu1

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone is willing to put in effort and genuinely cares about doing the task well.

example.english: You are really motivated to help, and the food you made is wonderful.
example.traditional: 你咁有心幫手，煮到咁多餸真係唔話得。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 jau5 sam1 bong1 sau2 zyu2 dou3 gam3 do1 sung3 zan1 hai6 m4 waa6 dak1

rows.note: Use this when the motivated person is showing initiative and taking an active approach, especially at work or in a project.

example.english: They are very motivated in the project and take the initiative to discuss collaboration.
example.traditional: 佢喺個計劃入面好積極，主動搵人傾合作。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 go3 gai3 waak6 jap6 min6 hou2 zik1 gik6 zyu2 dung6 wan2 jan4 king1 hap6 zok3
